slides.sub: Detaching right before a plan compounds.

slides.body: Ketu is a shadow planet linked to detachment, withdrawal and letting go. It can make you suddenly lose interest.
Under a strong Ketu theme, a plan may suddenly feel pointless. In the 2nd (savings) and 11th (gains) houses it can show up as quitting just when patience would pay off.

points: Write your reason before you start a plan
Wait a week before quitting on impulse
Talk to a licensed advisor on real decisions

slides.body: No yoga guarantees wealth, and no planet predicts a market. This is behavioral awareness, not financial advice or a stock pick.
Free Ketu Placement Check: see where you let go.
